PY = sys.executable

def compile_raw(raw):
    p = subprocess.run([PY, "-I", SUB, "compile"], input=raw,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout

def canon(v):
    return json.dumps(v, separators=(",", ":")).encode()

        "rules": [{"id": 7, "class": 2, "priority": 10,

        "fallback": {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0,

def mut(fn):
    import copy
    c = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
    fn(c)
    return c

fails = []
def expect_cfg_err(name, raw):
    rc, out = compile_raw(raw if isinstance(raw, bytes) else canon(raw))
    if rc != 2 or out != b'{"error":"config"}':
        fails.append((name, rc, out[:120]))

def expect_cfg_ok(name, cfg):
    rc, out = compile_raw(canon(cfg))

        return None
